_about: Malady Wise health-days calendar. Used by the monthly puzzle build and the home page. kind=day: theme every puzzle that day around puzzle_theme. kind=week: theme the first day only. kind=month: no full themed day; slip 2-4 related puzzles in across the month. tags: specialty = profession day; who = official WHO campaign; zebra = rare-disease angle; gentle = respectful tone, no jokes about patients or the condition; sensitive = home-page blurb only, puzzles NOT themed. If two days share a date, the lowest priority number leads (1 specialty, 2 WHO, 3 other); the other gets a mention in the blurb. Dates for variable days are pre-computed for 2026-2028; recompute from 'rule' for later years. Verify links before publishing; blurbs use Australian spelling. Edit this file directly (data/build-health-days.py is retired and must not be re-run).

days.blurb: A month off the booze (or another habit) for a good cause. February is short, which helps.
days.puzzle_theme: Alcohol and habits: liver health, dependence, behaviour change
days._note: 2026 run as a fundraiser for Lifeline (1-28 Feb).

days.name: National Wear Red Day (Go Red for Women)
days.blurb: Red today for women's hearts: heart disease is still the leading killer, and it doesn't always clutch its chest.
days.puzzle_theme: Heart disease in women: atypical presentations, SCAD, risk factors
days._note: US (American Heart Association), first Friday of February; 2026 confirmed 6 Feb, 2027-2028 computed.

days.name: Ovarian Cancer Awareness Month
days.blurb: Teal for February: the cancer with quiet symptoms and no screening test. Know the signs.
days.puzzle_theme: Ovarian cancer: symptoms, CA-125, BRCA, why there's no screening test
days._note: Ovarian Cancer Australia. Teal Ribbon Day was reported on 28 Feb in 2026 (same day as Rare Disease Day) but OCA's site doesn't list it, so it isn't a separate entry.

days.name: Hearing Awareness Week
days.blurb: A week to hear out the one in six Australians living with hearing loss. Pardon? Exactly.
days.puzzle_theme: Hearing loss: conductive vs sensorineural, audiograms, noise protection
days._note: Deafness Forum of Australia, 1-7 March each year; contains World Hearing Day (3 March). Shares 1 March with Zero Discrimination Day.

days.name: World's Greatest Shave
days.blurb: Shave, cut or colour in March for the Leukaemia Foundation and people living with blood cancer.
days.puzzle_theme: Blood cancers: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma
days._note: Leukaemia Foundation runs it through March; individual shave events are set by participants.

days.name: Purple Day
days.blurb: Purple for epilepsy today. Started by a nine-year-old in Canada, now worn worldwide.
days.puzzle_theme: Epilepsy: seizure types, seizure first aid, anti-seizure medicines

days.name: Heart Week (Australia)
days.blurb: Heart Foundation's week for heart health checks. Your ticker deserves a service.
days.puzzle_theme: Heart health checks: blood pressure, cholesterol, absolute CVD risk
days._note: 2026 confirmed 4-10 May; 2027-2028 computed as the first Monday-Sunday week of May, verify with the Heart Foundation.

days.name: Do It For Dolly Day
days.blurb: Go blue to end bullying. Dolly's Dream funds a 24/7 support line and school programs.
days.puzzle_theme: Bullying and youth mental health: impact, warning signs, getting help
days._note: 2025 (9 May) and 2026 (8 May) were the second Friday of May; 2027-2028 computed. In 2028 it falls on 12 May with International Nurses Day.

days.name: Mother's Day Classic
days.blurb: Walk or run on Mother's Day for breast and ovarian cancer research.
days.puzzle_theme: Breast and ovarian cancer: research, screening, survival gains
days._note: Held on Mother's Day (second Sunday of May); 2026 confirmed 10 May, 2027-2028 computed. In 2026 it shares the date with World Lupus Day.

days.name: Starlight Day
days.blurb: Starlight Children's Foundation brings fun and distraction to sick kids in hospital.
days.puzzle_theme: Paediatrics: children's hospitals, childhood illness, play in healing
days._note: 2026 confirmed Tuesday 19 May (third Tuesday of May); 2027-2028 computed, not yet announced. In 2026 it shares the date with World Family Doctor Day (priority 1 leads).

days.name: Australia's Biggest Morning Tea
days.rule: Thursday in late May, set yearly by Cancer Council
days.blurb: Cancer Council's cuppa for a cause. Scones fund research, prevention and support.
days.puzzle_theme: Cancer: prevention, risk factors and screening
days._note: 2026 (21 May) and 2027 (27 May) confirmed; 2028 computed as the fourth Thursday of May, not yet announced. Morning teas can be hosted any time in May or June.

days.name: Bowel Cancer Awareness Month
days.blurb: June is for talking about poo. Bowel cancer is very treatable when caught early.
days.puzzle_theme: Bowel cancer: iFOBT screening, colonoscopy, red-flag symptoms

days.name: Dry July
days.blurb: A month off alcohol to fund support for people affected by cancer. Your liver says thanks.
days.puzzle_theme: Alcohol and health: liver disease, cancer risk, drinking guidelines

days.name: DonateLife Week
days.blurb: Organ and tissue donation week. One conversation with family can save lives.
days.puzzle_theme: Organ donation and transplantation: brain death, matching, rejection
days._note: Australian Government DonateLife (not a fundraising charity). 2026 confirmed Sun 26 Jul - Sun 2 Aug; 2027-2028 computed from the last Sunday of July.

days.name: Jeans for Genes Day
days.blurb: Denim for discovery: Children's Medical Research Institute research into genetic disease.
days.puzzle_theme: Genetics: inheritance patterns, genetic disease, gene therapy
days._note: 2026 confirmed Thursday 6 August (2025 was a Friday). 2027-2028 computed as the first Thursday of August, verify each year. Falls inside Dental Health Week, which leads on priority.

days.name: National Stroke Week
days.blurb: Stroke Foundation's week to learn F.A.S.T. Face, Arms, Speech, Time: call 000.
days.puzzle_theme: Stroke: F.A.S.T. signs, thrombolysis and clot retrieval, prevention
days._note: 2026 confirmed 3-9 August; 2027-2028 computed. Same week as Dental Health Week and Homelessness Week (Dental Health Week leads on priority).

days.name: Kidney Action Week
days.blurb: Kidney Health Australia's week: kidneys can lose 90% of function before you notice.
days.puzzle_theme: Kidney health: CKD, eGFR and ACR, risk factors, dialysis
days._note: Formerly Kidney Health Week. 2026 listed as 10-17 August; 2027-2028 computed from the second Monday of August, verify with Kidney Health Australia.

days.name: Daffodil Day
days.rule: Thursday in August, set yearly by Cancer Council
days.blurb: Daffodils for Cancer Council: research, prevention and support for everyone touched by cancer.
days.puzzle_theme: Cancer: types, screening, oncology history
days._note: 2026 confirmed Thursday 20 August (third Thursday); 2025 was a Friday. 2027-2028 computed as the third Thursday of August, not yet announced.

days.name: Red Nose Day
days.blurb: Red Nose Australia funds research, education and bereavement support so fewer families lose a baby.
days.puzzle_theme: Safe sleep and pregnancy care: SIDS risk reduction, stillbirth prevention
days._note: Red Nose now holds it on the fourth Thursday of August; 2026 date (27 Aug) inferred from the official 'Red Nose Day Eve' on Wed 26 Aug. 2027-2028 computed. Keep puzzle wording gentle; no jokes about babies or loss.

days.name: Jersey Day
days.blurb: Wear your team's jersey to start a chat about organ donation. Started in memory of Nick Ross.
days.puzzle_theme: Organ donation: who can donate, consent, transplant immunology
days._note: 2026 confirmed Friday 4 September (first Friday of September); 2027-2028 computed. Update the year-specific link annually.

days.name: Prostate Cancer Awareness Month
days.blurb: September is for prostates. Australia's most commonly diagnosed cancer in men.
days.puzzle_theme: Prostate cancer: PSA testing debate, diagnosis, treatment

days.name: Steptember
days.blurb: 10,000 steps a day through September for Cerebral Palsy Alliance. Walk, wheel or swim it.
days.puzzle_theme: Cerebral palsy and the benefits of physical activity

days.name: R U OK? Day
days.blurb: Ask someone 'Are you OK?' today, and listen properly to the answer.
days.puzzle_theme: Mental health: depression, anxiety, starting a conversation, getting help
days._note: Second Thursday of September; 2026 confirmed 10 Sep. In 2026 it shares the date with World Suicide Prevention Day (sensitive, shown separately); keep puzzles strictly on supportive themes that day.

days.name: Breast Cancer Awareness Month
days.blurb: Pink October: funding breast cancer research, and a nudge to book that mammogram.
days.puzzle_theme: Breast cancer: screening, BRCA, treatment advances

days.name: Mental Health Month (NSW)
days.blurb: October in NSW is Mental Health Month, coordinated by WayAhead.
days.puzzle_theme: Mental health and wellbeing: common conditions, support, stigma

days.name: Great Cycle Challenge
days.blurb: Riders clock up kilometres in October to fight kids' cancer, funding Children's Medical Research Institute.
days.puzzle_theme: Childhood cancer: leukaemia, brain tumours, survival gains

days.blurb: Wear your loudest shirt for kids who are deaf or hard of hearing. Subtlety optional.
days.puzzle_theme: Childhood hearing loss: newborn screening, cochlear implants, glue ear

days.name: Bandanna Day
days.blurb: Bandannas on for Canteen, supporting young people aged 12-25 affected by cancer.
days.puzzle_theme: Adolescent and young adult cancer: types, treatment, survivorship
